question: Which factor is NOT suggested as supporting creativity?
solution: The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. Encouragement of conformity**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The passage suggests that creativity is supported by acceptance of failure, emotional openness, and flexible, supportive environments. (रचनात्मकता को समर्थन देने वाले कारकों में असफलता की स्वीकृति, भावनात्मक खुलापन और लचीला सीखना शामिल हैं।) • **Encouragement of conformity** is the opposite of what supports creativity—rigid, conformist models discourage experimentation and originality. • Thus, conformity is NOT a factor that fosters creativity according to the passage. Therefore, the correct answer is- Encouragement of conformity [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Acceptance of failure** (असफलता की स्वीकृति): The passage says emotional safety and acceptance of failure support creativity. • **Emotional openness** (भावनात्मक खुलापन): The passage directly mentions this as a factor in creativity. • **Flexible learning** (लचीला सीखना): Supportive and flexible environments help promote creativity. 42:T93f, The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. Fixed**.
